threats.threat: client asserts tenant, principal, role, approval or force-overwrite authority
threats.control: strict extra-forbid request plus server-derived RequestContext and closed AuthorizationPolicy field authority
threats.residual: RealPG RLS and route composition are deferred to P12D-030/040

threats.threat: model or client submits an unbounded mutation body
threats.control: closed typed Basic Info patch rejects raw row, plan_data, prompt, reasoning and tool results
threats.residual: handler must write only the frozen patch columns

threats.threat: retry identity is confused with semantic identity or crosses authority scope
threats.control: semantic hash binds target/version/body while idempotency digest binds server tenant/principal/action/target/key
threats.residual: atomic collision and replay persistence are deferred to P12D-040/050

threats.threat: receipt leaks identity or mutation body, or claims effects for a noncommitted outcome
threats.control: metadata digests replace raw authority/body and outcome validation forbids effect references outside committed
threats.residual: durable receipt lookup and log/event redaction are deferred to P12D-040/050
